scripts.db:migrations:apply: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.db:migrations:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.test:db: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && npx wrangler d1 execute DB --local --command="SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name IN ('products','orders','accounts','journal_transactions','journal_lines','inventory_ledger','audit_log') ORDER BY name"
scripts.test:db:integrity: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && node scripts/test-db-integrity.mjs
